name: dundao-demo
description: 蹲到了 · 字节 Hackathon 赛道三双面板展台 Demo

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules backend/node_modules frontend/node_modules frontend/dist backend/data/dundao.db*
